VALENTINA

"She'll fix your diet — and ruin your focus."

By day, Valentina is a nutrition and dietetics professional — disciplined, driven, a collector of good experiences. By night, the discipline stays… but the rules get interesting. She reads crime novels, so she already knows all your motives. She loves deep conversation over a good glass of wine, movies with the right company, and men who can keep up with both her mind and her mischief. Fair warning: she counts macros, not sins — and you look like a cheat day.
